description: Break the cyclic package dependency `providers` <-> `engine` that fails the routine build-test CI on both ubuntu and windows (`error: cyclic package dependency: package engine depends on itself`). Use Direction A (least invasive, most idiomatic for this codebase): make the `engine` crate self-contained by REMOVING its `providers` path dependency and its in-crate `impl ChatProvider for EmbeddedEngine`; move the `ChatProvider` implementation into the existing adapter layer at crates/providers/src/adapters/embedded.rs, which already depends on engine (one direction only, cycle gone). This mirrors how adapters/native.rs's `NativeAdapter` wraps the lower-level `HttpSseClient`. The engine keeps its GGUF model registry + lifecycle and exposes a provider-agnostic inference API (plain token strings + a crate-local stop reason); the providers adapter does the OpenAI ChatRequest/ChatResponse/ChatDelta/FinishReason shaping. The design goal is fully preserved: EmbeddedFactory stays registered in builtins.rs, priced ZERO, classified always-local/Embedded, surfaced under Local in the picker; the `llama` feature stays default-OFF with a dependency-light stub, and providers' `llama = ["engine/llama"]` passthrough still gates the real native path to the engine-native CI job. This is a build-blocker fix, so it MUST be verified structurally offline (crates.io is 403 in the sandbox); the default-feature compile is proven only by the routine build-test CI job and the native path only by the gated engine-native job.
steps: Edit crates/engine/Cargo.toml: DELETE the line `providers = { path = "../providers" }` from [dependencies]. Keep `domain = { path = "../domain" }`, all the crates.io deps (serde/thiserror/async-trait/futures-util/tokio), the OPTIONAL `llama-cpp-2 = { version = "0.1.121", optional = true }`, and the `[features] default = []` / `llama = ["dep:llama-cpp-2"]` block. Update the manifest header comment that says the crate 'implements providers::ChatProvider' to reflect that the ChatProvider impl now lives in the providers adapter and engine is self-contained (no path dep back to providers).

Edit crates/engine/src/lib.rs: REMOVE `use providers::{...}` and the entire `#[async_trait] impl ChatProvider for EmbeddedEngine { ... }` block. The engine must no longer reference any `providers::` type. Keep EMBEDDED_ENGINE_ID, DEFAULT_MAX_CONTEXT, NOT_COMPILED_MESSAGE, ModelEntry, EngineConfig (with resolve_path/register_path/register_with_id/find), and EmbeddedEngine (new/empty/register_path/register_with_id/registered_entries and a models-listing accessor). Replace `EngineConfig::model_infos()` (which returned `providers::ModelInfo`) with an engine-native accessor that returns the registered model ids (e.g. `Vec<String>` or `Vec<ModelEntry>`); the providers adapter maps these to `providers::ModelInfo` when implementing `list_models`.

In crates/engine/src/lib.rs, define a small crate-local, provider-agnostic result type for a completed generation so engine does not depend on providers' FinishReason: e.g. `pub enum StopReason { Stop, Length }` and an inference method surface. Under DEFAULT features expose a stub that returns a crate-local error carrying NOT_COMPILED_MESSAGE (e.g. `pub enum EngineError { NotCompiled, ... }` implementing std::error::Error via thiserror). Under `#[cfg(feature = "llama")]`, the existing `mod native` keeps the `llama-cpp-2` decode loop but its public entry point must return plain data: `(Vec<String> tokens, StopReason)` (or a streaming-friendly equivalent), NOT `providers::ChatResponse`/`ChatDelta`. Move `build_prompt` OUT of engine into the providers adapter (it consumes `providers::ChatRequest`/`MessageRole`); the engine's native `generate(model_path, prompt: &str, max_tokens: u32) -> Result<(Vec<String>, StopReason), EngineError>` should take an already-built prompt string so it stays provider-agnostic. Preserve the existing concurrency design: keep the dedicated `model_slot` mutex (cfg llama) separate from the registry `config` mutex, and keep running the CPU-bound decode via `tokio::task::spawn_blocking`. Expose an async engine method the adapter can call that acquires `model_slot`, resolves the model path from the registry, and drives `spawn_blocking(generate)`.

Rewrite crates/engine/src/lib.rs's `#[cfg(test)]` module to test only the engine's own surface (ModelEntry id derivation, EngineConfig path resolution, register/list/replace, EmbeddedEngine register+list, and - under default features - that the inference stub returns the NOT_COMPILED error via the crate-local EngineError). Remove test assertions that relied on `providers::` types (id()/capabilities()/ChatProvider stub errors) - those move to the providers adapter tests. Ensure every import used in tests is actually used (clippy -D warnings: no unused imports).

Rewrite crates/providers/src/adapters/embedded.rs to implement `ChatProvider` here. Define a wrapper type (e.g. `pub struct EmbeddedProvider { engine: engine::EmbeddedEngine }` or implement the trait on a newtype) and `#[async_trait] impl ChatProvider for EmbeddedProvider`: `id()` returns `engine::EMBEDDED_ENGINE_ID`; `capabilities()` returns streaming-text-only (streaming true; tools/vision/json_mode false; max_context Some(engine::DEFAULT_MAX_CONTEXT)) - move the `embedded_caps()` helper here; `list_models()` maps the engine's registered model ids to `providers::ModelInfo::new(id)`; `chat`/`chat_stream` under default features return `ProviderError::Other(engine::NOT_COMPILED_MESSAGE.to_string())`, and under `#[cfg(feature = "llama")]` build the prompt from the ChatRequest (move `build_prompt` here) and map the engine's `(Vec<String>, StopReason)` to a `ChatResponse` (single assistant choice) / a `BoxStream` of `ChatDelta`s ending with a terminal delta whose `finish_reason` maps StopReason::Stop->FinishReason::Stop and StopReason::Length->FinishReason::Length. Map any `engine::EngineError` into `ProviderError::Other(...)`. Keep `build_embedded(cfg)` (base_url -> EngineConfig::with_models_dir) and have `EmbeddedFactory::build` return `Arc::new(EmbeddedProvider::new(build_embedded(cfg)))`. Preserve `EmbeddedFactory` name, its `kind()` == ProviderKind::Embedded, and the no-secret-store behavior so builtins.rs registration and lib.rs re-export are unchanged.

Move the embedded-provider unit tests into crates/providers/src/adapters/embedded.rs #[cfg(test)] module: factory reports Embedded kind; builds without secret store / api key; instance.id() == "embedded"; capabilities() streaming-only; builds with models_dir from base_url; and (default features) that chat/chat_stream return ProviderError::Other with NOT_COMPILED_MESSAGE. Ensure imports are all used (clippy -D warnings).

Confirm crates/providers/Cargo.toml is UNCHANGED except (if needed) comments: it must KEEP `engine = { path = "../engine" }` and the `[features] llama = ["engine/llama"]` passthrough. This is the only remaining edge between the two crates and it is one-directional (providers -> engine), so no cycle remains.

Confirm .github/workflows/ci.yml needs NO change for Direction A: the routine build-test job already builds/tests/clippies `engine` (default features) BEFORE `providers`, and the gated `engine-native` job already runs `cargo build --manifest-path crates/engine/Cargo.toml --features llama`. Both still make sense. Only touch ci.yml if a step comment is now inaccurate (optional), and if touched, keep it valid YAML.

Offline verification: (a) manifest inspection - grep crates/engine/Cargo.toml to confirm NO `providers` path dep remains, and grep crates/engine/src/lib.rs to confirm NO `providers::`/`use providers` reference remains; confirm crates/providers/Cargo.toml still has the single `engine` path dep. (b) `cargo fmt --manifest-path crates/engine/Cargo.toml --check` and `cargo fmt --manifest-path crates/providers/Cargo.toml --check` (fmt works offline). (c) If ci.yml touched: `ruby -ryaml -e 'YAML.load_file(".github/workflows/ci.yml")'`. Do NOT attempt `cargo build/clippy/test` or `cargo metadata`/`cargo tree` - they hit crates.io and will 403; the cycle break is proven structurally offline and compilation is proven by CI.

Commit the change onto the `feat/embedded-inference-engine` branch with a clear message (e.g. `fix: break engine<->providers cyclic dependency by moving the ChatProvider impl into the embedded adapter (Strategy B)`). Do NOT push, do NOT open/merge a PR - the orchestrator pushes to update PR #25 and re-runs CI.
acceptance_criteria: crates/engine/Cargo.toml has NO `providers = { path = ... }` dependency (verified by grep/read).

crates/engine/src/lib.rs contains NO `providers::` reference and NO `impl ChatProvider` (verified by grep/read); the engine compiles conceptually against only domain + its crates.io deps + the optional llama-cpp-2.

crates/providers/Cargo.toml still has exactly one edge to engine: `engine = { path = "../engine" }`, plus the `llama = ["engine/llama"]` passthrough. The providers<->engine relationship is now one-directional (no cycle).

crates/providers/src/adapters/embedded.rs contains the `#[async_trait] impl ChatProvider` for the embedded engine wrapper, EmbeddedFactory still returns it, and its tests assert id()=="embedded", streaming-only capabilities, no-secret build, and NOT_COMPILED under default features.
EmbeddedFactory is still registered in builtins.rs and priced ZERO (unchanged); lib.rs still re-exports EmbeddedFactory (unchanged).
`cargo fmt --manifest-path crates/engine/Cargo.toml --check` and `cargo fmt --manifest-path crates/providers/Cargo.toml --check` both pass (offline).

The `llama` feature is still default-OFF; the native path stays behind `#[cfg(feature = "llama")]` in engine and behind the passthrough in providers; ci.yml's gated engine-native job still builds engine --features llama.
A commit exists on `feat/embedded-inference-engine` with the fix; nothing pushed.
verification: grep -n 'providers' crates/engine/Cargo.toml  => no path dependency line
grep -n 'engine = { path' crates/providers/Cargo.toml  => present (the one allowed direction)
ONLY CI can confirm: routine build-test (ubuntu+windows) compiles engine and providers with no cyclic error; gated engine-native compiles engine --features llama.
findings:
Broke the providers<->engine cyclic package dependency via Direction A (engine made self-contained; ChatProvider impl moved into the providers adapter). Committed on branch feat/embedded-inference-engine (not pushed).

- crates/engine/Cargo.toml: REMOVED `providers = { path = "../providers" }` from [dependencies]. Kept `domain` path dep, all crates.io deps (serde/thiserror/async-trait/futures-util/tokio), the OPTIONAL `llama-cpp-2 = { version = "0.1.121", optional = true }`, and `[features] default = [] / llama = ["dep:llama-cpp-2"]`. Rewrote the header comment: engine is now self-contained and the ChatProvider impl lives in the providers adapter (no back-edge, no cycle).
- crates/engine/src/lib.rs: REMOVED `use providers::{...}` and the entire `#[async_trait] impl ChatProvider for EmbeddedEngine`. Added a PROVIDER-AGNOSTIC inference API: `pub enum StopReason { Stop, Length }` and `pub enum EngineError { NotCompiled, UnknownModel(String), Inference(String) }` (thiserror; NotCompiled's Display is exactly NOT_COMPILED_MESSAGE). Kept EMBEDDED_ENGINE_ID/DEFAULT_MAX_CONTEXT/NOT_COMPILED_MESSAGE, ModelEntry, EngineConfig (resolve_path/register_path/register_with_id/find), and EmbeddedEngine (new/empty/register_path/register_with_id/registered_entries). - crates/providers/src/adapters/embedded.rs: MOVED the ChatProvider impl here. New `pub struct EmbeddedProvider { engine: engine::EmbeddedEngine }` with `#[async_trait] impl ChatProvider`: id() = engine::EMBEDDED_ENGINE_ID; capabilities() streaming-only with max_context Some(engine::DEFAULT_MAX_CONTEXT) via the moved `embedded_caps()`; list_models() maps engine::registered_model_ids() to ModelInfo::new; chat/chat_stream under default features return ProviderError::Other(engine::NOT_COMPILED_MESSAGE.to_string()); under #[cfg(feature="llama")] `build_prompt` (moved here, consumes ChatRequest/MessageRole) builds the prompt, engine.generate is called, and tokens/StopReason map to ChatResponse / a BoxStream of ChatDelta ending with a terminal finish_reason (map_stop: Stop->FinishReason::Stop, Length->FinishReason::Length); EngineError maps to ProviderError::Other. Kept `build_embedded(cfg)` (base_url -> EngineConfig::with_models_dir). EmbeddedFactory unchanged (kind()==ProviderKind::Embedded, no secret store) but `build` now returns Arc::new(EmbeddedProvider::new(build_embedded(cfg))). Moved the embedded-provider tests here (factory kind, no-secret build, id()=="embedded", streaming-only caps, models_dir from base_url, a list_models test, and default-feature NOT_COMPILED for chat/chat_stream).
- crates/tauri-app/src/commands.rs: updated the two call sites that used the removed `registered_models()` -> `registered_model_ids()`: load_embedded_model now checks `registered.iter().any(|id| id == &model_id)` and embedded_model_status_inner uses `registered_model_ids().await.len()`. Behavior unchanged.
